title: Southern Shores | KEY.co
description_expanded: AMENITY ACCESS: In order to park and have access to Seacrest Beach amenities, guests are required to complete the online Seacrest Beach HOA Guest Registration packet, prior to their arrival. A link will be sent after the reservation is made. Upon arrival, you can pick up your parking passes and wristbands at the Guest Service Window by the lagoon pool. Guests can enter the lagoon area amenity complex at any of the six gates. There will be a queue outside of the Guest Services office marked by safety yellow beach umbrellas. This beautifully renovated coastal home offers a perfect blend of style, comfort, and relaxation. With five spacious bedrooms, including two master suites, and multiple balconies, there’s ample space for sunning, enjoying the views, or simply unwinding. The open-concept living area creates a welcoming space for family feasts or cheering on your favorite team, making it ideal for entertaining. Every detail has been thoughtfully curated to enhance the experience, ensuring a stay that feels both effortless and indulgent.
